youtube_short.title: Wrong Debt Payoff Order Costs You $14,000
title_alternatives: The Debt Payoff Mistake Costing You $14K
Pay Off Debt in THIS Order — Save $14,000
youtube_short.description: If you have multiple debts and you're clearing the smallest balance first, you're paying thousands more than you have to. The debt avalanche — attacking your highest interest rate first — saves up to $14,000 in total interest compared to the popular snowball method. Same debts, different order, massive difference. Your brain loves quick wins. Banks love that even more. Switch the order tonight. #debtpayoff #debtavalanche #personalfinance #moneytips #debtfree #creditcarddebt
